title: Spectacular Spider-Man’s Creator Talks Sequel Efforts
content: There have been more animated takes on Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man than we can count at this point, for good reason. Peter Parker’s journey is an easy one to chronicle in the animation department, though there remains one entry in his long tale that fans are still dying to see.
author: ComicBook

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Director Teases Japan’s First-Ever IMAX Upgrade With New Teaser
content: Godzilla Minus Zero is set to be the first-ever IMAX production for a Japanese feature film release, and a special behind the scenes teaser has the director teasing what’s next from the big sequel.
author: ComicBook

title: Kagurabachi Hypes Crunchyroll Debut With New Teaser Trailers – Watch
content: Kagurabachi is set to make its highly anticipated anime adaptation debut with Crunchyroll , and the series has dropped some cool new teaser trailers to hype up the addition of new members to the voice cast.
author: ComicBook

title: Director, Scriptwriter Izuru Narushima Dies at 65
content: News agency Kyodo reported on Friday that award-winning scriptwriter and director Izuru Narushima died of lung cancer on August 24. He was 65. Narushima was born in 1961 in Yamanashi prefecture. He started work as a screenwriter in 1994 and made his debut as a director in 2004.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Reveals Scary New Sukuna Look With New Teaser
content: Jujutsu Kaisen is now hard at work on Season 4 of the anime, and has dropped a scary new look at Sukuna as it readies for the next half of the Culling Game. Jujutsu Kaisen returned for its highly anticipated third season earlier this year, and it ended up being one of the most popular seasons of the year overall .
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach’s Final Season Finally Returns With English Dub (New Release Schedule Revealed)
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is now back in action with its final season of episodes this Summer , and the English dub release of this final season has finally kicked off a new schedule of releases with Hulu.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece’s Live-Action Zoro Teases Future of The Netflix Series: “I’m Going to be 85”
content: Mackenyu has been an old hat when it comes to taking part in live-action anime adaptations. In his acting career, the young actor has been a part of adaptations such as Knights of the Zodiac, Fullmetal Alchemist, Tokyo Ghoul S, JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure, Rurouni Kenshin , and more.
author: ComicBook

title: Youka Nitta to Publish More Embracing Love Manga in Spring 2027
content: Nitta stated they do not know how much more they will draw for the series, but stated they will do their best "until they are dried out." They also thanked readers for their passionate requests and suggestions about drawing moments that take place during breaks in the main story.
author: ANN

title: BLEACH: TYBW Part 4 Features Uryu Ishida Changes in Episode 6 Ending Video
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War (TYBW) Part 4 The Calamity premiered Episode 6 “THE END” on August 29 with new changes to its ending video. While the majority of the video is unchanged, there are several frames that now feature Uryu Ishida.
author: Anime Corner

title: Arcanadea Anime Reveals Teaser Trailer, January 2027 Release Date
content: ARCANADEA anime revealed its first teaser trailer, along with a January 2027 release date. The anime is based on Kotobukiya’s Arcanadea plastic model series, which launched in December 2021 with an “SF x Fantasy” concept and original character designs by necömi.
author: Anime Corner
